title: polygala polymorpha var. uliginosa
intro: Polygala polymorpha var. uliginosa, commonly known as Marsh violet or Marsh polygala, is a plant species in the Polygalaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its health benefits of acting as an expectorant and anti-inflammatory. The therapeutic actions of Polygala polymorpha var. uliginosa include stimulating the respiratory system, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
